title: Babis app event request
description: Body of POST /api/v1alpha1/app-events, sent by the ArgoCD notifications controller on an edge. One Application per request. Unknown fields are allowed at every level. A null sync, health or revision means ArgoCD has not set the value yet; it is stored as an empty value.

edge.description: Edge name. DNS-1123 subdomain: dot-separated labels of lowercase a-z, 0-9 and '-', each starting and ending alphanumeric; 1..253 chars.

event.description: state: the Application exists with this state. deleted: the Application has a deletion timestamp.
